[Unit]
# The Status tunnels run under wallet-pir-control-sessions since 2026-09-30.
After=wallet-pir-control-sessions.service

controller@coordinator.fragment_text:
[Unit]
Description=Status live publication qualification controller
After=network-online.target status-control-tunnel.service
Wants=status-control-tunnel.service

[Service]
ExecStart=/opt/status-pir/releases/d481baad0504093e/status-pir serve-distributed --config /etc/status-pir-control/controller.json --cookie /root/.cache/zakura/.cookie
Environment=RAYON_NUM_THREADS=2
Environment=RUST_LOG=info
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5
MemoryMax=4G
MemorySwapMax=0
CPUQuota=200%
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/status-pir-controller
PrivateTmp=true

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

router@status-01.fragment_text:
[Unit]
Description=Status PIR CPU packing router (private qualification)
After=network-online.target status-worker.service

[Service]
User=status-pir
Group=status-pir
ExecStart=/opt/status-pir/releases/cb259772123b82691e05fd1b7846033e1f5e35c7b9178da3c4945d55a3ad703c/status-pir role --role router --network-hex 08ce3d9731b000c08338455c8a4a6bd05da16e26b11daa1b917184ece80f0400 --listen 127.0.0.1:8482 --query-listen 127.0.0.1:8484 --artifact-origin http://127.0.0.1:8481 --worker-origin http://127.0.0.1:8481 --state-dir /var/lib/status-pir-router-native
Environment=RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4
# Worker and router prepare serially; one thread let the full-occupancy rebuild
# outlive the 20-second freshness limit. Preparation threads run at nice 10.
Environment=STATUS_PREPARATION_THREADS=6
Environment=RUST_LOG=info
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
MemoryMax=3G
MemorySwapMax=0
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/status-pir-router-native

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

worker@status-01.fragment_text:
[Unit]
Description=Status PIR CPU evaluation worker (private qualification)
After=network-online.target

[Service]
User=status-pir
Group=status-pir
ExecStart=/opt/status-pir/releases/cb259772123b82691e05fd1b7846033e1f5e35c7b9178da3c4945d55a3ad703c/status-pir role --role worker --network-hex 08ce3d9731b000c08338455c8a4a6bd05da16e26b11daa1b917184ece80f0400 --listen 127.0.0.1:8481 --artifact-origin http://127.0.0.1:8495 --state-dir /var/lib/status-pir-worker-native
Environment=RAYON_NUM_THREADS=4
# Candidate preparation has its own pool at nice 10, below query evaluation.
Environment=STATUS_PREPARATION_THREADS=6
Environment=RUST_LOG=info
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=3
# The CPU worker keeps host copies of the database, hints and retained
# generations. Under 20 QPS with live blocks it grew past 6 GiB and was
# OOM-killed after about 50 minutes on 2026-09-27; the host has 16 GiB.
MemoryMax=12G
MemorySwapMax=0
NoNewPrivileges=true
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/status-pir-worker-native

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
